subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your company has</#if> received a notification on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali.
body2: A notification is a legally-binding communication consisting of a notice of receipt and one or more documents.
body3: <#if recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The company has up to 120 days from the notification completion date to access the documents. The deadline for payment, if required, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
read_more: You are receiving this notice of receipt as a <#if recipientType=='PF'>natural person<#else>legal person with Fiscal Code ${recipient.taxId}. SEND is a tool that makes the sending of notifications by the Public Administration safer, more efficient and cheaper. Find out more
footer: The sending institution knows this PEC address because <#if recipientType=='PF'>you<#else>the company entered it in <#if recipientType=='PF'>your<#else>its SEND contact details, because it is part of one of the registries provided for by the Digital Administration Code, or because it was communicated to <#if recipientType=='PF'>them in the past. To change your contact details or add new ones, go to your contact details.
